tools.name: discourse_search
tools.description: Search topics, posts, users and categories of the forum for a term. Returns matching posts and topics with their ids. Discourse API: GET /search.json?q=.

tools.name: discourse_list_latest_topics
tools.description: List the latest topics of the forum, newest activity first by default. Discourse API: GET /latest.json.

tools.name: discourse_list_top_topics
tools.description: List the top topics of the forum for a period. Discourse API: GET /top.json.

tools.name: discourse_get_topic
tools.description: Get one topic with its title, category, tags and the first posts of its post stream. Discourse API: GET /t/{id}.json.

tools.name: discourse_get_post
tools.description: Get one post with its raw Markdown, author and cooked HTML. Discourse API: GET /posts/{id}.json.

tools.name: discourse_list_categories
tools.description: List the categories of the forum with their ids, slugs and colours. Discourse API: GET /categories.json.

tools.name: discourse_list_tags
tools.description: List the tags of the forum with their topic counts. Discourse API: GET /tags.json.

tools.name: discourse_get_user
tools.description: Get a user's profile by username: name, trust level, groups and activity counts. Discourse API: GET /u/{username}.json.

tools.name: discourse_list_notifications
tools.description: List the notifications of the user the key acts as: replies, mentions, likes and messages. Discourse API: GET /notifications.json.

tools.name: discourse_list_private_messages
tools.description: List the private message topics received by a user. Discourse API: GET /topics/private-messages/{username}.json.

tools.name: discourse_get_site_info
tools.description: Get the forum's basic information: title, description, logo and version. Discourse API: GET /site/basic-info.json.

tools.name: discourse_create_topic
tools.description: Create a new public topic in a category as the key's user. Publishes content on the forum: confirm the text first. Discourse API: POST /posts.json.

tools.name: discourse_reply_to_topic
tools.description: Post a reply in an existing topic as the key's user. Publishes content on the forum: confirm the text first. Discourse API: POST /posts.json.

tools.name: discourse_mark_notifications_read
tools.description: Mark all notifications of the key's user as read, or one notification by id. Discourse API: PUT /notifications/mark-read.json.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: discourse_search, discourse_get_topic, discourse_get_post, discourse_list_notifications, discourse_list_private_messages, discourse_mark_notifications_read · Private data: discourse_list_private_messages · Public sink: discourse_get_topic, discourse_get_post, discourse_create_topic, discourse_reply_to_topic.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: discourse_search, discourse_get_topic, discourse_get_post, discourse_list_notifications, discourse_list_private_messages, discourse_mark_notifications_read · Private data: discourse_list_private_messages · Public sink: discourse_get_topic, discourse_get_post, discourse_create_topic, discourse_reply_to_topic

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
